subject: Retention briefing — manager action items and escalation
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Retention briefing — manager action items and escalation

Team,

Q1 engagement results are out. High-level callouts: a noticeable uptick in 'intent to leave' in Product Eng (levels IC3-IC5) and a smaller but concentrated signal in the Sales AE cohort. I pulled the summary and attached the engagement_summary_Q1.pdf — see pages 2–4 for team-level nets and verbatim themes.

I need us to move from signal to action this week. Proposed immediate asks: 
- Managers to complete the attached manager_action_tracker.csv (one row per at-risk employee) by EOD Friday. Columns: name, manager, top 2 concerns, proposed intervention, owner, ETA.
- People Ops (cc'd pending) to share historical retention offers and estimated budget impact.
- Leadership to prioritize top-10 at-risk profiles for proactive outreach and retention options.

Please reply with who owns each of the three bullets above (we can split ownership). I will escalate to People Ops and Finance once we have the tracker.

Why now: this cohort overlaps with several upcoming product milestones. Losing senior ICs will materially impact delivery and hiring load. We should be decisive and document trade-offs.

Attachments referenced: engagement_summary_Q1.pdf, manager_action_tracker.csv

Thanks —
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Retention briefing — manager action items and escalation

Karthik — thanks for pulling this together. Quick notes and proposals: 

1) Ownership: I will own the manager_action_tracker consolidation and will reach out to managers on Monday morning for a 30-min sync.
2) Assignments (provisional):
   - Product Eng at-risk list: Jonas Weber (lead on outreach & 1:1s)
   - Sales AE cohort: Marissa Cole (lead on quota/comp review and retention incentives)
   - HR coordination & offers: Naomi Feldman to coordinate with HR-Benefits (cc'd)

3) Initial manager asks (to send to managers when I kick off): short 30-min touch with each flagged person, identify top 2 drivers, offer 1 concrete support (role change, comp/bonus, training, or schedule adjustment). Document in tracker.

I attached a short template in the tracker column headers and added two example rows for reference. If HR can send historical offer bands, that will speed decisions.

- Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of People Programs
Redwood Inference
